race.description: Book For Christmas Meeting Sat 12th Dec (Bm55) Hcp
race.comment: ANTHROPOLOGY (9) sets the standard off a last-start Class B win at Eidsvold, where she was sent out odds-on and beat I Am Pietra by just over a length. The move into stronger company is the main test, but she gets weight relief, has been holding her form well and brings a strong jockey-horse record. HOLY CROWN (10) is the proven local option, with a win and four placings from nine starts at this track and a last-start Bowen second in BM50 grade when beaten just over half a length as favourite. GOTTA HERO (8) has the right recent profile after winning a BM60 two back and placing as favourite in a BM50 at Emerald, with the claim helping offset the rise in grade. LONHY'S FABRE (2) has placed at both runs this campaign, owns a strong track-and-trip record and rates as the reliable placing danger if he can turn those consistent thirds into a sharper finish.
